top_signal.title: Need More Customers? Don't Ignore These Platforms.
top_signal.summary: Hi,   As we know that the internet has changed dramatically since AI tools became publicly available. Until 2023, the formula was pretty straightforward. Rank your website on Google's first page, and boom.. Thousands of leads per month.    [Note:   If you've outsourced your marketing, make sure your agency follows these methods. Otherwise, you're paying for marketing while missing out on opportunities to grow your business. ]   But now, search methods have diversified. People are searching for businesses on ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and other platforms. Customers' journey doesn't start with Google only.   So, if you want more customers, here's what you need to do.   ________    1. Get your business discovered everywhere:  Don't depend entirely on Google rankings. Build visibility across Google, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and the other platforms your potential customers use.    Why it matters : when people search for a service, compare businesses, or ask AI for recommendations, you want your business to have a chance to be discovered. AI recommendations are considered more seriously than even influencers.   __________    2. Now, You Must Understand how to get your business mentioned and cited:  Look at the image attached in the comment. ChatGPT and Google AI Mode mention many of the same brands, but they cite different sources.
